summary: A note on the cost of network software, using the survey mechanisms that hosts use to see who is up as an example of wasted overhead. MIT-DMCG and UCLA-NMC agreed on a standard format for host survey data and would make it available, so others need not poll. The title is a quote from complaints.

eli5.summary: Lots of computers keep asking others are you awake, which costs effort. Instead, a few will ask and share the answer.

questions: why surveying arpanet hosts is costly
